prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: transparent PNG character illustration for the MyStarQuest dinosaur asset collection.
Primary request: Redraw the imaginary flying dinosaur from input image 1 in the polished 3D cartoon rendering style of the project's dinosaur assets in input images 2–4.
Input images: Image 1 is the user's photographed pencil drawing, the authoritative character design and pose reference. Images 2 (green pteranodon), 3 (pink tyrannosaurus), and 4 (teal quetzalcoatlus) are supporting STYLE references only; do not substitute their characters or anatomy for the imagined creature.
Subject: One cheerful imaginary flying dinosaur, front facing, floating upright with both broad wings extended sideways and two long blue legs hanging below. Preserve the original's distinctive design: pink elongated rounded torso, pale cream oval face, one eye winking and one large expressive glossy dark eye, tiny nose and sweet closed smile; tall red triangular crest with two smaller pink pointed projections beside it and swept-back pink frill along the sides of the head. Broad curved batlike wings with red upper rims, dark brown/near-black upper membrane bands, lime-green middle panels and turquoise scalloped lower panels. The cream heart-shaped patch in the center of the pink belly contains a simple cute dinosaur-head emblem, with a dark dot eye and small triangular teeth, translated from the drawing into a clean integrated emblem. Two long cobalt-blue legs ending in pale three-toed feet.
Style/medium: Match the references' high-quality family animation 3D character look: charming rounded sculpted forms, soft studio lighting, subtle fine pebbled skin, gentle shading and highlights, clean readable silhouettes and expressive eyes. Let the original invented anatomy and bright colours remain recognizable.
Composition/framing: Single centered full-body character, full wingspan and both feet entirely visible, generous small transparent margins. Approximately square canvas accommodating both the wide wings and hanging feet. Make the character feel like the same little creature from the drawing brought into the reference dinosaur world.
Scene/backdrop: Real transparent alpha background, isolated character, no environment, no ground plane or cast shadow.
Constraints: Preserve the drawing's colours, wink, upright pose, crest, unusual multicoloured wings, blue legs and heart belly emblem. No photograph, paper, desk, pencil texture, typography, logos, watermark, extra characters or props. Do not turn it into a conventional pterosaur, human, or unicorn.
